title: Playful mischief?
content: I’m brand new to this sub and stoked to learn it exists. My mall world has been expanding and intensifying the last few years. Does anyone else go on little adventures within the mall world? Most of the time when I’m visiting I am mischievous but in a playful way. Going into areas or doing things I’m not supposed to, getting chased by authority figures (security or teachers), but it’s not serious. It does seem like that action has some role, though. This morning I was accessing restricted areas that included rooms/levels of colored fabrics and then a dark lazy river that led to other parts in the mall. I’d run to different storefronts to hide and escape security. When I was caught, shortly before waking, I was in a service elevator with a security guard but instead of getting into trouble it’s like they had a new “mission” for me.
